name: Pocket2Mol
one_liner: E(3)-equivariant autoregressive 3D molecular generator inside protein binding pockets, which samples ligands atom by atom inside the pocket; docking (QVina) scores evaluate finished molecules.

loop.proposes: An E(3)-equivariant graph neural network places frontier atoms, 3D coordinates, and covalent bonds step by step inside a protein pocket.
loop.steers: Ligands are sampled atom by atom inside the pocket.

headline_result: Generated drug-like 3D molecules with more realistic torsion angles and stronger Vina binding scores than 3D voxel baselines on CrossDocked2020.
caveat: Autoregressive atom-by-atom placement can accumulate geometric error if an early frontier atom is poorly positioned.
beyond_harness_note: An E(3)-equivariant 3D geometric network samples ligands atom by atom inside the pocket, and docking (QVina) scores evaluate finished molecules.
algorithmic_authority: QVina docking score, used to evaluate finished molecules

sources.title: Pocket2Mol: Efficient Molecular Sampling Based on 3D Protein Pockets (ICML 2022 / arXiv:2205.07249)

verification.notes: Checked against Peng et al., ICML 2022.
